If you have a persistent shoulder muscle knot, your discomfort might actually be coming from your shoulder blade. Learn how to fix it.Many people struggle with neck pain relief because they overlook the role of the scapula.
This video explains how a misaligned shoulder blade disrupts the surrounding anatomy, leading to tension that radiates upward. It is designed for anyone experiencing chronic tightness who wants to understand the mechanical connection between their back and neck.
